description: This file defines an enumeration 'Zoom' used in a PDF viewing or processing context within the PdfSharp.Windows namespace. It specifies various zoom factors for a PDF preview control, including predefined percentages and special values for fit-to-page and original size options.

classes.name: Zoom
classes.description: An enumeration that specifies different zoom options for a PDF preview control, including fixed percentages and special fitting modes.
